(2) The shot cuts to a close-up of her face as she points to her glowing cheek area; she then holds up a red jar of OLAY skincare cream. (3) She demonstrates the application process, rubbing the cream onto her cheeks and forehead using her fingers with upward massage motions. (4) She uses a small metallic scraping tool to massage her jawline and cheekbones in an upward direction. (5) A split-screen comparison appears, showing a side-by-side view of her face; she then appears lying in a bed with white pillows, showing her bare face to the camera. (6) Returning to the studio background, she holds the red jar again, talking excitedly with wide eyes and animated hand movements.
